name: The Bike Boy
about: Building up to meeting Dash (Hayden's day 1 playtest, 11 Nov 2026): Rex's twin is always off on his bike tinkering. Follow his tyre tracks and the gadget bits he dropped to his lab, catch his runaway Buzz Bot, then he gives you the Star Popper's blueprint and his gadget stall opens: buy one. Then the Gloop King, and Dash sends you on to Pip. scripts/meetings.gd puts the tracks, parts and bot in at play time.

steps.text: Rex says his twin Dash zoomed off on his bike and dropped bits of gadget everywhere. Follow the glowing tyre tracks from the Skate Park and pick up what he dropped.
checklist: A springy coil, by the Skate Park
A fizzing bulb, by the gate to the houses
A tiny cog, outside Dash's house

steps.text: The tracks end at a shed past Dash's house. Something inside is going BZZZT. Go and see who's in there.
Dash's Buzz Bot has got loose and it's zooming round the lab! Catch it: walk right into it.
Dash gave you the Star Popper's blueprint for catching his bot, and his gadget stall in the Market Square is open! Take the blueprint to his stall and he'll build you one.
checklist: Have a look at Dash's gadget stall in the Market Square
Buy the Star Popper at Dash's stall

steps.text: Dash says there's a big golden Gloop with a kingdom of his own, through a gooey gate in the west fields past the Market. Pop the Gloop King, then tell Dash!
checklist: Pop the Gloop King in his kingdom (the gate's in the west fields)

reward.message: You met Dash, and the Void's got a new Gloop King champion! Dash says Pip's been waiting by the portal for you! (+10 sparkles)
